clean_report_minimum_schema.artifact_sha256: exact SHA-256 of closed candidate, not workspace or prior ZIP
clean_report_minimum_schema.commands: Root clean validator supplies actual commands, exit codes, source of installed interpreter/module, function/continuation results

gates: build requires explicit frozen-tree acknowledgement; no source mutation
exact one official4.5 WHL/PYD and all required source/evidence trees
CRC, complete manifest/hash inventory, safe unique member paths
extract only into a new path and only after full verification
publish requires root authorization and a PASS clean report naming the candidate exact hash
all existing outputs protected; final ZIP name created atomically without replace
external proof and small review files remain outside the unchanged ZIP
transport splits only if compressed ZIP >20MiB, into exactly two sequential binary parts
two part hashes, streaming concatenation, actual temporary reconstruction and rebuilt container are verified
scope: Integrity checks are not functional/scientific validation; root clean validator remains mandatory. No fallback imports, PYTHONPATH injection, legacy engine, installer or science automatically runs.
